meta.title: FF14 NVIDIA Hosted Subtitle Benchmark
methodology: Use six FF14 quest dialogue lines from Purple Flame, Purple Flame as subtitle-style English input.
Send one request per subtitle line with a subtitle-only localization prompt.
Apply per-model no-think switches where NVIDIA documentation or live tests showed them to work.
Measure end-to-end latency, usable subtitle rate, finish reason, visible thinking leakage, and heuristic translation accuracy.
Accuracy score is heuristic: concept coverage plus reference-string similarity. It is good for side-by-side comparison, not a human localization replacement.

dataset.speaker: Estinien
dataset.text: If we are to lure our foes to our position, then we must find a means of producing a signal of purple hue.
dataset.reference: 若要引敌前来，我们必须想办法发出紫色信号。

dataset.speaker: Iceheart
dataset.text: So, you seek to stem the Dravanian tide with talk? A romantic notion.
dataset.reference: 你想靠言语阻止龙族攻势？真是天真的想法。

dataset.speaker: Iceheart
dataset.text: If you but knew the truth─the spark which lit the flames of this animosity─you would understand the futility of your quest.
dataset.reference: 若你知晓点燃这场仇恨之火的真相，便会明白你的追求有多徒劳。

dataset.speaker: Estinien
dataset.text: I believe reason has all but left him. Through the Eye, I feel much of what Nidhogg feels, and the dragon's thirst for vengeance will not be quenched by aught less than a sea of blood.
dataset.reference: 我觉得他几乎已经失去理智。透过龙眼，我能感受到尼德霍格的所思所想，而那条龙对复仇的渴求，唯有血海方能平息。

dataset.speaker: Iceheart
dataset.text: You still believe that a peaceable solution can be found? Very well. I will take you to him.
dataset.reference: 你竟还相信能找到和平的办法？也罢，我带你去见他。

dataset.speaker: Iceheart
dataset.text: Our road will lead us to Dravania, the homeland of dragonkind. There we shall ascend unto the clouds, where Hraesvelgr resides...
dataset.reference: 我们的路将通往龙族的故乡德拉瓦尼亚。我们将在那里登上云端，赫拉斯瓦尔格便栖居其上。
